name: Instagram (Meta)
appType: Meta app with Instagram API (Instagram Login)
summary: Works for your own accounts on day one (Standard Access). Serving other businesses needs Advanced Access: Business Verification first, then App Review with a screencast for every permission. Only Business and Creator accounts are supported.

composio.note: Composio-managed works for basic flows. Composio notes that comment management needs permissions Meta must approve on the app, so some actions need your own app.

capabilities.label: Manage accounts you own
capabilities.why: Standard Access: works for people with a role on the app

capabilities.label: Publish for customers' accounts
capabilities.why: Advanced Access = App Review + Business Verification

capabilities.label: Manage comments / DMs
capabilities.why: Each permission is reviewed with its own screencast

gates.label: Business verification
gates.plain: Meta checks your legal business documents.

steps.title: Create a Meta app (Business type) and add Instagram
steps.detail: developers.facebook.com/apps → Create app → add the Instagram product (Instagram Login). Add redirect URIs (Composio BYO: https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback).
steps.agent: Configure the product, redirect URIs and webhooks
steps.human: Create it with a Meta developer account

steps.title: Add test users and a Business/Creator account
steps.detail: Standard Access only works for accounts with a role on the app.
steps.human: Switch the test IG account to Business or Creator and accept the tester invite

steps.title: Business Verification (Meta Business Manager)
steps.detail: Legal name, address, phone and a matching document or domain. Do this first: App Review won't succeed without it.
steps.agent: Collect and check the documents for name/address mismatches
steps.human: Upload legal docs and confirm the phone or email

steps.title: Privacy policy, data deletion URL, app icon, Live mode
steps.agent: Draft the privacy policy and a data-deletion callback/instructions page

steps.title: Record a screencast for each permission
steps.detail: Show the full user journey: connect the account, grant the permission, then use it in your UI.
steps.agent: Write the shot list, reviewer test steps and usage notes for each permission

steps.title: Submit App Review for Advanced Access
steps.detail: Request only what you use. Every extra permission needs its own justification.

blockers.fix: You only have Standard Access. Get Advanced Access (Business Verification + App Review).
